main.description: A sidebar entry that features a top-level thread as a channel. Only counts when written by the repo that owns the community.lexicon.thread.group the thread belongs to. Deleting it demotes the thread back to a plain thread.

section.description: Sidebar heading the channel sits under. Absent means the default section.

position.description: Sort order within the section, lowest first.

icon.description: A single emoji or character. Absent means the app's default channel icon.
